localChanges: Computer players now keep more defenders in a city when enemy units are close by, up to three, and move spare defenders from quiet cities to the ones that need them (closes #423).

log: Civ1's Knowledge#defendersWanted is a quarter of a city's size plus one with an enemy unit next to it, at least one (Segment_1ade.cs F0_1ade_0421), and at least as many as the enemy units able to attack within 3 tiles, up to 3 (civ-clone/web-renderer#423). #defendersKept is size / 4 + 1, or size / 3 + 1 with an enemy next to it (AIEngine.cs L858-930); v474.05's extra defender in the capital is left out, as it cost about a tenth of power and score in the arena. Enemy means a player with no peace treaty. Garrison keeps and StandDown calls idle defenders in to the kept count; reviewCities lets a city with a spare fortified defender release the weakest one turn in eight, staggered by city (releaseDefenders).
